snippet.title: Opus 5.5 Made Claude Code Unstoppable | 7 Levels in 13 Minutes
snippet.description:
👉 Get started with Claude Code on the Max plan: http://clau.de/TristenObrien
#ad #Anthropic_Partner | This video is sponsored by Anthropic @claudeai

Claude Opus 5.5 made Claude Code unstoppable, and most people are barely scratching the surface. In this video, I break down the 7 levels of a Claude Code user, from building your first app in the desktop app to having Claude work on its own while you're away. By the end, you'll know if you've mastered all seven, or exactly which one to focus on next.

Chapters:
0:00 Intro: the 7 levels of Claude Code
0:29 Level 1: The Describer
2:16 Level 2: The Talker
3:36 Level 3: The Planner
4:51 Level 4: The Perfectionist
6:36 Level 5: The Multi-Tasker
8:05 Level 6: Work From Anywhere
9:58 Level 7: Unstoppable
12:43 Wrap-up

Resources:
Install Claude Code: https://code.claude.com/docs
Git basics: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/10167454-use-the-github-integration
/ultrareview guide: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/ultrareview

Which level are you at? Let me know in the comments.

#ClaudeCode #Claude #AI
